title: Staff-Level SoC Verification Strategy Review
description: Create and review a staff-level SoC verification strategy covering VIP reuse, coverage, formal/liveness, debug triage, regression gates, and signoff risks.

steps.title: Step 1: Define Strategy Boundaries
steps.instructions: Open `strategy_template.md` and fill sections 1 to 3: split responsibilities across block, subsystem, SoC, firmware and formal owners and test layers; justify every agent's mode by who drives its interface; and write the firmware–testbench contract with one register predictor per writing bus.

steps.title: Step 2: Build the Coverage and Liveness Plan
steps.instructions: Fill sections 4 to 6: measurable system coverage goals traced from features to checks; formal/liveness properties with trigger, obligation, failure meaning, owner, and whether each is an unbounded liveness proof or a bounded safety check; and the system scenarios (reset, errors, power, concurrency, connectivity, CDC/RDC).

steps.title: Step 3: Add Debug, Regression, and Risks
steps.instructions: Fill sections 7 to 9: the failure evidence package, first-divergence triage and bucketing, the smoke/nightly/stress/signoff suites with numeric closure gates and owners, and the risk register.

steps.title: Step 4: Peer Review Against the Rubric
steps.instructions: Score your plan with the rubric in section 10, writing the evidence for every row, before you open `model_solution.md`. Then compare with the model answer to identify missing staff-level reasoning.
